neighbours.label: a function word (the/of/and) immediately before the name of a great power or international body (the Soviet Union, of the United Nations)
fire: During the Cold War, Washington competed for influence with the Soviet Union.
The resolution was passed by the Security Council of the United Nations last week.
In 1914, France and Britain went to war against the German Empire.
The summit brought together leaders from Russia and the People's Republic of China.
Spain lost most of its colonies to the United States in 1898.
The army fought for years against the Ottoman Empire in the Balkans.
Grain exports from Ukraine were negotiated with the European Union.
The fleet was sent to protect British interests against the Russian Empire.
quiet: During the Cold War, Washington competed for influence with great energy.
The resolution was passed by the board of the local school last week.
In 1914, France and Britain went to war after a long summer.
The summit brought together leaders from the farming and fishing towns.
Spain lost most of its ships to a terrible storm in 1898.
The army fought for years against the cold in the mountains.
Grain exports from the farm were negotiated with a small buyer.
The fleet was sent to protect the harbour against the winter storms.

notes: card: ' the' x11 before Soviet Union / United Nations / German Empire; probe 0.35-0.43 on such contexts vs ~0 on ordinary nouns. Also fires on '8' in years and '_' in version strings (not covered).
